About LANGMAI

A paper packaging partner for practical B2B programs.

Jinhua Langmai Daily-Using Co., Ltd. has supplied food paper products from Jinhua City, Zhejiang Province, China since 2006. We work with importers, distributors, bakeries, foodservice buyers and private-label brands that need clear specifications, responsive sampling and export-ready packing.

Company profile

Clear product decisions make repeat orders easier.

The product range covers cake cups, cupcake liners, muffin and tulip cups, baking parchment, air fryer liners, greaseproof wrapping paper, paper straws and selected paper accessories.

Buyers can discuss paper type, dimensions, forming, printing, color, pack count, retail presentation and export-carton requirements as one controlled specification rather than sourcing each step separately.

Wilson Wu is the named contact for overseas inquiries, helping connect product requirements with samples, document review and quotation follow-up.

How we support a project

From first brief to repeat supply.

01

Define the application

Confirm the food, dimensions, use conditions, destination market and quantity.

02

Select the construction

Match paper, treatment, shape, print, color and pack format to the approved use.

03

Review samples

Check appearance, dimensions, forming, odor, grease resistance and packing.

04

Approve the specification

Record accepted material, size, artwork, pack count, carton details and inspection points.

05

Produce and inspect

Manufacture against the approved version and review lot and shipment preparation.

06

Support repeat supply

Use the approved specification as the reference for reorders and controlled changes.

Factory capability

Printing, converting and packing for food paper formats.

The exact process depends on the approved construction and intended use.

Printing

Artwork, colors and low-odor ink options are reviewed against the selected paper.

Roll processing

Paper rolls can be processed for the selected coating, treatment, width and downstream format.

Converting

Slitting, sheets, perforation, die-cutting, forming and bag making support finished formats.

Packing

Bulk, foodservice, retail and private-label packs can be planned with export cartons.

Markets and buyer types

Built for international purchasing workflows.

LANGMAI serves buyers in Middle East, North America, Europe, United Kingdom, South America. Typical customers include Importers, distributors, bakery and confectionery buyers, large supermarkets. Support can cover mixed-product inquiries, private-label artwork, samples, target-market documents, retail packing and export cartons.

Quality and documentation

Evidence is reviewed against the product and market.

Available files include previews or documents associated with BSCI, BRC, ISO, FSC, LFGB, DGCCRF and PFAS-related review. Buyers should confirm current validity, issuing party, tested construction, intended use and market applicability for the exact item being ordered.
